decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones, using cards like Faithless Looting, Thought Scour, and Persist. Once these creatures are in the graveyard, they can be brought back onto the battlefield using cards like Unearth and Reanimate, creating a powerful reanimation combo that can overwhelm the opponent. Protection and disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help stall the opponent while the reanimation combo is set up, leading to a potential game-winning play.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively play low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. The deck focuses on utilizing cards that can be played efficiently, such as Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with cheap instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain to help dig through the deck and find key pieces to continue the aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to maintain aggressive pressure on the opponent by utilizing a combination of efficient creatures like Voice of Victory, Guide of Souls, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Mana Tithe to control the board and protect the aggressive creatures. The mana base includes a mix of both red and white sources to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The key focus of this deck is to efficiently generate mana through Ruby Medallion and rituals, while utilizing Ral, Monsoon Mage and Hex Magic to cast a large number of spells in a single turn. The deck aims to combo off by casting Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard, eventually finishing the opponent off with Grapeshot. The deck also utilizes Wish to search for key pieces and has some land flexibility with Gemstone Caverns and Valakut Awakening. Overall, the deck aims to quickly and explosively win the game through a powerful storm combo.

The main goal of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. With powerful cards like Ajani, Guide of Souls, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a steady stream of threats. Additionally, cards like Lightning Bolt and Thraben Charm provide removal options to clear the way for attacks. By combining a mix of creatures and spells, the deck seeks to outpace the opponent and secure victories through quick and efficient plays.

The key concept of this deck revolves around fast mana generation using cards like Pyretic Ritual and Manamorphose to cast spells like Grapeshot and Past in Flames multiple times in a turn. Ruby Medallion helps reduce the cost of spells, while Ral, Monsoon Mage provides additional card advantage. The deck also includes ways to find specific cards with Wish and Valakut Awakening, and has ways to protect key combo pieces with Wrenn's Resolve. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful storm of spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and card draw to combo off with Grinding Station, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate infinite mana and mill the opponent's library. The key strategy is to control the board with counterspells and disruptive creatures like Loki, God of Mischief, while setting up the combo pieces. The Skateboard is used to untap artifacts for added value, and the addition of Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber help to ramp and draw into key pieces. The deck aims to win through a game-ending combo rather than traditional combat.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through Birthing Ritual to cast powerful creatures such as Shardless Agent and Harbinger of the Seas. It also utilizes counterspells like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it includes cards like Subtlety and Endurance for further control and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive strategy while maintaining tempo and control through its card selection and mana generation.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and efficient spells to overwhelm opponents quickly. It includes cards that can generate mana, draw cards, and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter with powerful spells like Unholy Heat, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Emry, Lurker of the Loch allows for flexibility and consistency in creating threats and maintaining pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to establish a fast board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan effectively.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key concept of this deck is to constantly apply pressure with fast creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while using cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge to control the board and clear the way for an all-out assault. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional ways to buff your creatures and push for lethal damage. This deck aims to win quickly and decisively in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on taking advantage of efficient creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Solitude, along with disruption cards like Galvanic Discharge and Ephemerate, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain control of the board. Utilizing a variety of colors allows for flexibility in dealing with different types of threats, while cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional reach and resilience in longer games. The deck's mana base is also carefully constructed to support its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of creatures and direct damage spells. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply pressure on the opponent, while also using Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge as removal spells. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride provide additional creature support, while Seasoned Pyromancer helps generate card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Boromir, Warden of the Tower disrupt opponent's strategies, while Ranger-Captain of Eos and Voice of Victory provide utility and additional options. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this Jeskai Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells, removing threats from the board, and ultimately overwhelming them with card advantage and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent. With a mix of control elements and card advantage engines, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in order to secure victory in the long game.

The main concept of this Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to quickly lower your own life total in order to empower Death's Shadow and other cards that benefit from your life being low. By playing aggressively and utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, you can control the game while also putting pressure on your opponent. Stubborn Denial and Drown in the Loch provide protection and disruption, allowing you to maintain your advantage and come out on top in the 1 vs 1 format of Modern.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells and card advantage engines to outvalue the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By using a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to control the game tempo and eventually win through powerful finishers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude. The deck also includes cards like Quantum Riddler and Ephemerate to generate card advantage and protect key threats. The mana base is fine-tuned to support the three-color requirements of Jeskai Control.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes a mix of low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to apply early pressure, supported by powerful threats like Scion of Draco and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help protect your creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Stubborn Denial provides additional protection for your key creatures, while Lightning Bolt serves as versatile removal. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility in casting your spells.
